unplottable.why: Ameren's Appendix I redacts project names and locations in the public version, and program-level items carry no location at all.

ComEd identifies these only by internal circuit designator (X4859, D3429, J8031...) or files them as scope 'System Wide.' Its public hosting-capacity map uses anonymized feeder IDs (F0001-F5516) with no public crosswalk - verified: 0 of 41 tested identifiers matched.
